name: tanwir-gateway
description: Subdomain routing gateway for tanwir.institute — proxies each subdomain to its own app.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n gateway,consent,emailer,admin,tlp -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "next dev --port 3000" "npm run dev --prefix consent" "npm run dev --prefix emailer" "npm run dev --prefix admin" "npm run dev --prefix tlp"
